why: s-schedules I-508: a figure restated in brackets in the other unit — F-ARCH's wall type `250 (0'-10")`. The figure before the bracket governs; the bracket settles a bare figure's unit where exactly one of the schedule's units makes the figure round to it (250 mm is 9.84", which rounds to 10"; 250" does not). A figure stating its own unit keeps it; a restatement that settles nothing reads nothing.
